data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 Property results benefited from a lack of major loss activity during the calendar year and favourable development which has resulted in releases from prior year reserves. This book continues to perform very well and it has been possible again to release reserves from prior years.

named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate's most notable catastrophe event occurred in December when the UK experienced a series of storms for which reserves have been established.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding was GBP 590.774m (2014). The report does not quantify a gross prior-year reserve movement; narrative describes favourable development and releases from prior year reserves, particularly in Property and US Casualty lines, while December UK storms in 2015 led to establishment of reserves (adverse for that event). No explicit gross prior-year movement figure is provided in the notes; therefore a numeric gross prior year development cannot be determined from the disclosed information.
